## Objective

Construct the positive-parameter pole compactification and its Hamiltonian
action finite part, including a nonempty source window that enters the pole
basin with a uniform first-hit margin.

## Proof obligations

- [ ] Derive the dominant positive-parameter pole balance from the full spatial
      equations.
- [ ] Write the compactified and desingularized vector field exactly.
- [ ] Identify the boundary invariant set and prove its hyperbolicity.
- [ ] Compute and normalize the indicial spectrum, including all resonances.
- [ ] Determine the action density order from the exact primitive.
- [ ] Prove a parameter-uniform entry theorem for a nonempty pole source window.
- [ ] Construct the finite Laurent--log subtraction in fixed physical remaining
      spatial time.
- [ ] Prove mixed parameter regularity, coordinate uniqueness, and compatibility
      with the finite-branch exact-action identity.

## Acceptance

Claim V3 becomes **Proved** only after both the local finite-part theorem and the
global entry statement are established.  A formal dominant balance is not
enough.
